## What's new in Void Deck 0.2.1

This release merges the latest upstream Void Deck work while preserving the English-first interface and all fork customizations.

- Restyled game details page with a full-screen header, dot-matrix play information, and Void Deck controls.
- Dot-dissolve animation when leaving Home.
- Home navigation now focuses on Home, Library, and Friends.
- Quick Access tab focus ring no longer gets clipped.
- English is the default language, with Spanish available in Settings.
- Settings include accent color, controller glyph style, Home density, reset-to-defaults, and release status.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from URL*, then paste the URL for `VoidDeck-v0.2.1.zip`. It replaces the previous version.
